title: Zero-Parameter Two-Doublet Law and the 10-Observable Flavour Readout

scope.frame: Coupling tensors on data-free 2-torsion line w = (2/5, 1/10) across B1757's strip and the exact arithmetic geodesic apex tau_* = (1 + i*sqrt(84))/3

claim_one_line: ZERO-PARAMETER TWO-DOUBLET LAW AND 10-OBSERVABLE FLAVOUR READOUT (P-329, P-357, P-363, P-366, P-377): on data-free line w = (2/5, 1/10), the up-sector Yukawa Gram operator Sigma^(up) in Higgs-direction space strictly confines to 1+2 diagonal blocks with off-block norm = 0.0 (singlet e_0 Frobenius-orthogonal to doublets {e_1, e_2}), while down-lepton Gram matrices satisfy exact parity reflection Sigma^(lep) = P_e1 Sigma^(down) P_e1; the zero-parameter two-doublet laws built from inverse-Gram operators and up-sector Gram boost lambda_{(1,+i)}/lambda_{e1} ~ 1.981 reduce chi^2_nine from 567-1073 (single-Higgs v_DR) to 25.89 at apex tau_* and 26.31 at center, predicting physical Jarlskog CP invariant |J_CKM| = (2.67-2.78) x 10^-5 (within 2.0-2.7 sigma of PDG (3.08 +/- 0.15) x 10^-5 vs -20.5 sigma for single-Higgs v_DR). 0 of 19.
